description: Research web pages through the GroundTab Chrome extension.

interface.shortDescription: Research the web through your Chrome extension.
interface.longDescription: GroundTab adds read-only MCP tools for autonomous discovery and page extraction through the paired GroundTab Chrome extension. The local broker starts with the plugin and pairs once without exposing browser cookies or a long-lived credential.
defaultPrompt: Research this topic with GroundTab and cite the final source URLs.
